QUOTE: "Calls `client.createPost` again. This is a fresh POST, so the server assigns a new post ID." and "On failure, it sets `failed: true` again, unless the error is one of the three terminal errors above, in which case it removes the post."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer describes retryFailedPost as a single new createPost call (with no retries, retryLimit 0) that on failure re-marks the post failed or removes it for the same three errors.
